scope: Main-process runtime efficiency sampling now has a host-api surface and a persisted Settings > Developer opt-out with a fail-closed readout. No performance claim.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Settings switch can be turned on and off; disabling stops the interval work with no residual timer, and the persisted setting is read back through host-api.
acceptanceResults.evidence: electron/services/efficiency-api.ts setEnabled -> stopRuntimeEfficiency/startRuntimeEfficiency + setSetting('efficiencySamplingEnabled'); tests/unit/runtime-efficiency-api.test.ts asserts persistence and running state; src/components/settings/EfficiencySamplingPanel.tsx toggles it.

acceptanceResults.criterion: host-api exposes the latest sample plus the bounded rolling summary and shed state; a read failure surfaces an error rather than a silently empty value.
acceptanceResults.evidence: HostApiContract.efficiency.getState -> RuntimeEfficiencyState { enabled, running, measured, summary, shed }; RuntimeEfficiencySummary carries latest + rolling aggregates; the panel toasts toUserMessage(error) on failure instead of rendering empty data.

acceptanceResults.criterion: The renderer reads the sampler only through host-api/api-client; no new ipcRenderer.invoke or direct gateway HTTP.
acceptanceResults.evidence: src/lib/host-api.ts adds hostApi.efficiency via invokeHost; the panel imports hostApi only. No ipcRenderer/Gateway HTTP added.

acceptanceResults.criterion: All four locales carry the new strings and the i18n lint passes; an Electron E2E spec covers the switch and the readout.
acceptanceResults.evidence: en/zh/ja/ru keys added (13 each) and `pnpm run i18n:lint` passed. tests/e2e/settings-efficiency-sampling.spec.ts executes in a real Electron boot and passes: toggle -> host-api getState reads back false/true, fail-closed not-sampled readout asserted before the first sample. jsdom coverage of the same interaction remains in tests/unit/efficiency-sampling-panel.test.tsx (3 tests).

acceptanceResults.criterion: Before any real sample the UI states 'not sampled' and never renders a healthy zero.
acceptanceResults.evidence: efficiency-api collapses the sampler's zeroed pre-sample summary to null with measured:false; tests cover it at the API and panel level; the panel renders settings-efficiency-not-sampled and hides the sample/cpu readouts.

acceptanceResults.criterion: No performance improvement is claimed; no frozen product default is changed.
acceptanceResults.evidence: Docs/spec claim no improvement; efficiencySamplingEnabled defaults to true, preserving the pre-existing always-on behaviour.

gates.result: 1 passed (switch toggles, persists through host-api, fail-closed not-sampled readout); run 3x on 2026-10-12

limitations: The Electron Playwright spec initially could not run: vite build failed with '[vite:esbuild-transpile] remove ...: Access is denied'. Root cause was isolated on this host (not a repo defect and not this change): the pnpm store's @esbuild/win32-x64 0.27.4 esbuild.exe carried a Windows Low mandatory integrity label (SACL), so the esbuild service process ran at Low IL and could not unlink the transform temp file created by Node at Medium IL. Replacing the labelled binary with a byte-identical clean copy from the npm registry made the unmodified tree build and run E2E (verified: esbuild lib/main.js SHA-256 578f8144...C05A equals the pristine 0.27.4 package; vite build exit 0; E2E 1 passed x3).
GitHub Actions E2E still cannot substitute for local evidence: jobs fail to start because of an account billing/spending limit.

git diff --check flags CR-at-EOL on electron/main/index.ts / ipc-handlers.ts because those files are stored CRLF upstream; the same class of flag is present in the already-merged #160 commit. With core.whitespace=cr-at-eol the diff check is clean.
No performance improvement is claimed; a stored before/after artifact pair is still required.

readmeReview.note: Adds a Settings > Developer toggle + readout for an existing local diagnostic. READMEs do not enumerate Settings toggles and make no efficiency-performance promise, so no textual update is required.
